{{Quote|But we're so close to finishing the trial&hellip;''"<br />"''No. We are not. I see you have a signal beacon. Leave it for us, and as soon as we have gathered our things, we will signal for a ride back.|Avitla and Mennaus|audio=Avitla-Mennaus-LightSide-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Mennaus''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], they accompanied fellow Padawans [[Jerridan]] and [[Avitla]] in seeking information about the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]] in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

The group's [[Jedi Trials/Legends|trials]] were then interrupted by a [[Flesh Raider]] [[Flesh Raider uprising|attack]] and Jerridan was injured when the trio [[Death/Legends|killed]] one of the agressors. As Mennaus tended Jerridan's wounds, Avitla proposed that they keep fighting, but another Padawan arrived and agreed with Mennaus that the group should return to safety, giving the Zabrak a [[Signal beacon/Legends|signal beacon]] to summon a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We came seeking knowledge of the Jedi Code. The Flesh Raiders interrupted our trial.''"<br />"''Never fought like that in my life. We killed it, but Jerridan was badly injured.|Mennaus and Avitla|audio=Mennaus-Avitla-Fought-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:EarlyLessons-PadawanTrio-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Avitla stands over a wounded Jerridan while Mennaus kneels beside him in the Tythonain Gnarls.|Mennaus tended to Jerridan's wounds after their fight with a Flesh Raider.]]
Mennaus was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and served as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during its [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> they undertook their [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trails]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], where the Zabrak accompanied the Padawans [[Jerridan]] and [[Avitla]] to the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region to seek knowledge of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]] without their Masters.<ref name="TOR" />

In the Gnarls, the trio's trials were interrupted by an [[Flesh Raider uprising|attack]] by the [[Flesh Raider]]s [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Tython. Although they all lacked combat [[Jedi training/Legends|training]], the three Padawans managed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a Flesh Raider, although Jerridan was badly injured in the process. As Mennaus tended to the wounded [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Avitla propossed that they keep fighting to complete their trials. Although Mennaus disagreed, they told her that they could help Jerridan along should they continue.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
[[File:FleshRaiders-GnarlsCage-SWTOR.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=A trio of Flesh Raiders stand around a Padawan captured in a crude metal cage in the Tythonian Gnarls.|Mennaus did not wish to continue fighting the Flesh Raiders in the Tythonian Gnarls after Jerridan was injured.]]
A Jedi Padawan with combat training then approached the trio, having been sent to the Gnarls to search for them by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relnex]], a watchman at the nearby [[Gnarls Outpost|Jedi training grounds]]. After Avitla and Mennaus informed the new arrival about what had happened to them, Avitla asked the Padawan to help them fight the Flesh Raiders and continue their trials. Mennaus objected and the Padawan agreed that the three Padawans needed to return to safety. They then handed the Zabrak a [[Signal beacon/Legends|signal beacon]] that Relnex had provided so that they could summon a rescue [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] for transport out of the Gnarls. After convincing Avitla that it was time to go, Mennaus told the Padawan they would leave as soon as they had gathered their things.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It is not the Jedi way to seek battle and revenge while a man suffers.|Mennaus|audio=Mennaus-Suffers-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Mennaus disagreed with Avitla's wish to seek vengance on the Flesh Raiders, beliving that it was not the Jedi to seek vengance or to prioritise battle while their comrade was injured. The Zabrak had tan skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|How's he looking?''"<br />"''He should be resting in the Jedi Temple. But if you're determined to press on&hellip; I can help him along.''"<br />"''Give him the last of the kolto if you have to. We'll fight again soon.|Avitla and Mennaus discuss Jerridan|audio=Avitla-Mennaus-Kolto-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
While in the Gnarls, Mennaus wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] with a white trim and a white sash [[Belt/Legends|belt]]. The Zabrak also had green [[Boot/Legends|boots]], a [[Lightsaber training staff|training saber]], and had access to medicinal [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mennaus appeared in the quest "Early Lessons" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. Only players of the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] or [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] class may take the quest and refusing to aid the Padawans in fighting the Flesh Raiders is considered the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light Side]] option. While this article assumes players took the Light Side option, there is also the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] option to agree to help Avitla by taking on the Flesh Raiders head on while Avitla, Mennaus, and Jerridan flank them. Chosing this options causes Mennaus to simply say "[[May the Force be with you/Legends|May the Force be with you]]" to the player, who then has to kill ten Flesh Raiders and destroy three sets of their supplies. When the player reports this to Relnex they can warn the watchman that the trio of Padawans will be coming back angry.<ref name="TOR" />
